# Escape - AI-Powered Offensive Security Platform

> > Escape provides AI-powered offensive security tools including Attack Surface Management (ASM), Business Logic DAST, and AI Pentesting for modern APIs and web applications.

Escape specializes in dynamic application security testing (DAST) with a focus on GraphQL, REST APIs, and modern web stacks. The platform integrates with CI/CD pipelines and offers automated vulnerability scanning, business logic testing, and AI-driven remediation for organizations like Visma, Schibsted, and Wiz.

## Key Topics

- DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing)
- Attack Surface Management (ASM)
- API Security
- GraphQL Security
- Business Logic Testing
- AI Pentesting
- BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization)
- DevSecOps
- CI/CD Integration
- Vulnerability Scanning
- Offensive Security
- Security Automation
- WebApp Testing
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
